entries.9442bb2d48891f98: It states its purpose as 'Fulfilling our responsibility to create the present of the world together and our responsibility to connect to the future through maritime logistics.' Its medium-term management plan 'FORWARD 2030 Ⅱ Challenge for innovation and further growth with U', covering fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2027, sets a vision for 2030 of 'aiming to be an indispensable presence in clean and sustainable maritime transport, continuing to transform in collaboration with stakeholders, and further enhancing corporate value', and sets out 'expanding new growth business domains' and 'deepening existing core business domains' as its business strategies. Following its environmental roadmap toward carbon neutrality by 2050, it has also set a target to reduce annual greenhouse gas emissions by 25% by 2030 compared with 2019.
